title: Algorithmic Trading Bot with Backtesting
description: Build an algorithmic trading bot with backtesting engine, moving average crossover strategy, and performance metrics.
briefing:
### Mission Objective
Develop an algorithmic trading bot that implements a moving average crossover strategy. Build a backtesting engine to evaluate strategy performance against historical data with key financial metrics.

### Environment
- Ubuntu 22.04 LTS with Python 3.12
- Pandas, NumPy, and TA-Lib pre-installed
- Working directory: /opt/algo-trading-lab
- Historical price data provided in CSV format

### Tasks
1. Load and parse historical OHLCV price data from CSV
2. Implement a Moving Average Crossover strategy (SMA 20/50)
3. Create a backtesting engine with portfolio tracking
4. Calculate Sharpe ratio, max drawdown, and win rate
5. Generate trade signals with entry and exit points
6. Add position sizing and risk management rules
7. Create visualizations of equity curve and drawdowns
8. Write a report summarizing strategy performance

### Permissions & Access
- Container runs as root
- Python 3.12 with financial libraries
- Data files in /opt/algo-trading-lab/data/
